candidate_rule: CLAIM → PROJECTION → CAMERA DISTANCE / FOCAL LENGTH → FIRST-READ → ROLE VERDICT
truth_boundary: Synthetic geometry only; not C04 geometry, field view, or measured lens match.
external_reference: Blender Manual: perspective makes distant objects smaller and parallel lines converge
Blender Manual: shorter focal length increases field of view; longer focal length reduces field of view
Blender Manual: orthographic keeps apparent object size independent of distance
Blender Manual: lens shift can change framing/vanishing-point placement without rotating geometry

design_crit.v1: REVISE — orthographic crop clipped the ridge; camera contract printed literal newline escapes; role claims were too implicit.
design_crit.v2: KEEP FOR TRAINING — all views fit, role claims are explicit, same geometry is preserved, and camera emphasis is legible.
